summary: flights get-departures and get-aircraft-trajectory default begin to now-1h and end to now when omitted, via a PATCH(opensky-time-window-defaults) block in each command.
reason: OpenSky requires begin/end on every /flights/* endpoint and rejects bare calls with HTTP 400, but anonymous access caps the window at 1 hour (a 2-hour window 404s). Generated help text already promised the defaults; the code never delivered them. Defaulting to the last hour makes `flights get-departures --airport KJFK` work as documented.
validated_outcome: go build ./... and go vet ./... pass; live smoke: get-departures --airport KJFK with no window returned 23 flights; dry-run shows begin/end injected as now-1h..now.
